text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=infra-inference-prod

pagerduty: PagerDuty — Incident 4820000001 created and routed to #eng-oncall. Severity: SLO-BURN (p95 > 1200ms). Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/4820000001

maria (oncall): ACK — I'm on it. Pulling dashboards (latency, kvcache, autoscaler). Any early context?

kevin: looking now — spike appears focused on eu-west. p95 ~2200ms, p99 ~4500ms. Error rate normal. KV-cache evictions high, GC spikes on sidecars.

linda: autoscaler shows min-replicas = 4 for eu-west, it hit the cap and didn't scale. Possible hotkey or sudden traffic fanout.

maria (oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic from eu-west to eu-central for 30m; 2) temporarily reduce batch size on the heavy model variant; 3) request +2 GPUs if scaling needed. Sam, can you apply the route change?

sam: doing route shift now — `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood/runtime/routes/shift" -d '{"from":"eu-west","to":"eu-central","pct":100}'` — done. Wait a few seconds...

sam: observed improvement: p95 in eu-west (after shift) dropped from 2200ms -> 1300ms within 60s. p99 still elevated. Continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: Note: alert auto-paging suppressed after ack from maria (oncall).

kevin: digging into hosts: `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep eu-west` — sidecar mem usage high and `redis` shows `evicted_keys > 5000/min`. Looks like a hotkey causing cache thrash and higher CPU on model hosts.

linda: I've notified infra to temporarily raise pool capacity (+2 GPU nodes) — request submitted to #infra and tagged @infra-oncall.

maria (oncall): customer impact: increased latency observable for EU customers on short-generation endpoints; we haven't seen consumer-facing 5xx spike. CS alerted to prepare for support tickets. Marking severity: P2 (latency-only, partial region).

sam: applied temporary config: `batch.max_tokens=256 -> 128` for model variant `v3-heavy-eu` (applied via rollout canary). Monitoring for quality regressions.

sam: after batch reduction + route fallback, overall p95 (global) down to ~850ms, eu-west p95 ~1100ms, p99 ~2.6s. Still above SLO but trending down.

maria (oncall): good. Next steps: keep fallback for 15m, allow autoscaler increase to land, infra to confirm GPU nodes. If p99 still > 3s after 20m, escalate to PD-major.

kevin: I'll own the postmortem and runbook update. Likely action items: lower autoscaler min cap recommendation, add prefix-KV guard for hotkeys, improve alert-to-runbook mapping.

linda: CS update posted: "We are investigating a regional latency issue in EU; partial degradation only. Engineering is mitigating." :white_check_mark:

sam: handoff — I'm primary for the next 2h to watch the rollback and autoscaler. Maria -> Sam handoff complete. :raised_hands:

maria (oncall): thanks. Leaving notes in incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/4820000001 — adding assignees kevin (postmortem), sam (monitoring), linda (customer comms). I'll check back before my shift end.

maria (oncall): LAST UPDATE — 4820000148 — closing active paging. We'll keep alerting at lower thresholds and prepare follow-up. :lock_with_ink_pen:
